content.text: USU assoc w Lt → Rt shunt (noncyanotic)
MC type of congenital Hdz in childhood
•one of MC pathologic murmurs in childhood
Sm to mod assoc w Lt → Rt shunt - lrg (unrestricted) defects may eventually develop Rt → Lt shunt (Eisenmenger syndrome)
: USU multi holes in “swiss cheese” pattern
: located posterior to septal leaflet of TV
: beneath PV - may aortic valve insuff
•also by septal zone: AV canal · musc · dist conal
Norm P differences b/n ventricles maintained
•USU aSx @ birth & develop sxs after a few wks
•↑shunt to RV & lungs → LA enlrg & CHF - pulm congestion · pulm HTN · hepatomeg
•freq resp infect · slow wt gain · dyspnea · diaphoresis · fatigue as early as 1-6mo
•Rt → Lt shunt (cyanotic) occurring w lrg (unrestricted) VSDs
: pulm HTN · Eisenmenger syndrome · HF · dysrhythmias
-best heard @ LLSB (3rd-4th ICS) - radiates over entire precordium
•smaller VSDs USU louder & assoc w more palpable thrills than lrger ones
•lrg defects may have little or ⍉murmur (free flow b/n ventricles)
•murmur ↑ w handgrip & squatting (↑PVR) · ↓ w standing abruptly & Valsalva (↓preload) · ⍉chg w LLDP
•may assoc w thrill or diastol rumble @ mitral area
•Lt or Rt ventricular heave & systol thrill in mod/lrg defects
: may be norm · show Lt atrial enlrg or RVH
•CXR & EKG often norm esp w sm VSDs
→ further anatomy · estimate pulm a. pressures
*most close w.in 12mo - remaining close by early school yrs
: diuretics (furosemide · spironolactone) · inotropes (dopamine · milrinone) · supplemental O2 · calorie supp
: Sxtomatic infants or uncontrolled CHF · growth delay · recurr resp infect
Lrg shunts repaired by 2yrs of age to prevent pulm HTN
•lrg VSD w norm PVR → surg after FTT · tachypnea · diaphoresis w feeds - often @ 3-6mo
•⍉IE abx prophylaxis for unrepaired VSD - only select pts w repaired defect
